entities.name: Giants
entities.description: A species of massive, humanlike creatures, mostly dim and violent and most strongly aligned with red mana.

entities.name: Frost giants
entities.description: Intelligent, secretive giants of Kaldheim's Surtland who use runic magic to divine the Cosmos.

entities.name: Fire giants
entities.description: Brutal, impulsive giants of Surtland who raid and war on the frost giants.

entities.name: Storm Giants
entities.description: A larger variety of giants living in the Kingdom of Storms in Eldraine's clouds.

entities.name: Yorvo
entities.description: A giant and the king of Garenbrig.

entities.name: Beluna Grandsquall
entities.description: The queen of the Kingdom of Storms, ruling from the castle of Stormkeld.

entities.name: Jötun
entities.description: A tribe of Dominarian giants that aided the Kjeldorans in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: The order the Kjeldorans fought during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: An archon who used the war against the giants as a pretense for evil actions.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Extremely powerful elder giants who ruled Theros's ancient past before being sealed away in the Underworld.

entities.name: Hurda
entities.description: A docile species of giants on Zendikar used as pack animals.

entities.name: Turntimber Tribe
entities.description: A tribe of Zendikar giants on Ondu who practice druidism.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose giants are known as sunder shamans.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane with giants of all colors.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane with giant tribes and hurdas.

events.summary: During the Ice Age some Jötun giants aid the Kjeldorans against the Order of Stromgald.
events.quote: some Giants of the Jötun tribe aided the Kjeldorans in the fight against the Order of Stromgald .

events.summary: On Theros, the gods battle the titans and seal them in the Underworld, where they remain until they break free.
events.quote: The gods of Theros battled them and sealed them away in the Underworld, where they remained until they broke free.

events.summary: During the Age of Trax Theros giants have kingdoms, and Agnomakhos uses the war against them as a pretext for evil actions.
events.quote: Agnomakhos used the war against the giants as a pretense for his evil actions
